requirements.requirement: The system must define a Pydantic model representing a prescription record that includes NPI, drug identifier, prescription volume, and time period.
The system must enforce validation that NPI is a 10-digit numeric identifier in the prescription model.
The system must define a normalized drug identifier field (e.g., NDC or mapped code) within the prescription schema.
The system must define a MongoDB collection schema for storing prescription records aligned with the Pydantic model.
The system must define a mapping structure that links each prescription record to one or more ICD-10 condition codes.
The system must support many-to-many relationships between drugs and ICD-10 condition codes in the mapping contract.
The system must define a Pydantic model for provider-level aggregated prescription data keyed by NPI.
The system must define a normalized score output contract that includes NPI, condition, score value, and score explanation fields.
The system must constrain normalized score values to a defined numeric range (e.g., 0 to 1 or 0 to 100).
The system must include metadata fields in the schema indicating data source (e.g., Medicare Part D) and ingestion timestamp.
The system must reject prescription records that are missing required fields (NPI, drug identifier, or volume) during model validation.
The system must handle invalid ICD-10 codes by flagging them as unmapped rather than failing schema validation.
The system must support extensibility in the schema to accommodate additional prescribing attributes without breaking existing contracts.
The system must ensure all schema definitions are serializable to JSON for storage and API compatibility.
